Question 3
?

The population of pines in a forest increases by 100 trees every year. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the population P(t) of the pines? Assume that the time t is measured in years.

a
dPdt=100
b
dPdt=100+P
c
dPdt=e100
d
dPdt=100P
e
dPdt=100k,k>0
